injuries.summary:
## Injury briefing

### Biggest status changes
- **Vikings DE Jamal Adams**: diagnosed with a **season-ending knee injury** after being carted off in the preseason game. His year is over before it began.
- **Bears RB Kyle Monangai**: left practice after a knee injury, but early tests suggest the knee is **structurally sound**. He’s believed to be **fine**, pending an MRI.
- **Cardinals WR/TE Jeremyiah Love**: HC **Mike LaFleur** said it’s still **unclear** whether the injury is a low or high ankle issue.
- **Cardinals QB Carson Beck**: his **ribs issue is day to day**. LaFleur said the discomfort is still there, and Arizona wants him to heal a bit more.
- **Quinn Ewers**: now **week to week** with a groin injury sustained Friday, and he had already been dealing with another undisclosed issue through camp.
- **Texans**: several notable non-participants, including **Tank Dell**, **Jaylin Noel** (pinkie finger/hamstring), **Brevin Jordan** (knee), and **British Brooks** (broken hand).
- **Dolphins OL Jamaree Salyer**: placed on **season-ending IR**.
- **Patriots RB Terrell Jennings**: reached an **injury settlement** and is now a free agent.
- **Patriots OL Andrew Rupcich**: expected to have an injury settlement too; his injury is **not season-ending**.

### Notable returners / players back on the field
- **49ers WR Deebo Samuel**: got shaken up during practice but **returned and finished**.
- **49ers WR Jacob Cowing**: also got shaken up, **returned**, and finished practice.
- **49ers WR KhaDarel Hodge**: was **back in pads and uniform** after missing Saturday.
- **49ers DE Nick Bosa**: had his **first side-field workout** since the tendinitis/soreness issue began, a step in the right direction.

### Other injury notes to watch
- **49ers** added **G Dominick Puni (concussion)**, **WR Demarcus Robinson (undisclosed)**, and **DT Gracen Halton (ankle)** to the non-participant list.
- **49ers DT C.J. West** and **DE Titus Leo** were both hurt during practice and needed help getting up; they did not finish.
- **49ers PUP list** still includes **TE George Kittle (Achilles)**, **RB Isaac Guerendo (pec)**, and **DL Mykel Williams (ACL)**.
- **Commanders QB Marcus Mariota** is set to miss significant preseason time for the third straight year.
- **Harbaugh** said there may be a **groin injury** issue for **Miller**, who expects to miss time.

### Why it matters
- The biggest fantasy/roster hits here are **Jamal Adams** (done for the year), **Jamaree Salyer** (season-ending IR), and any prolonged absence for **Tank Dell** or **Carson Beck**.
- For the **49ers**, the encouraging part is that **Deebo Samuel, Jacob Cowing, and Nick Bosa** all showed signs of progress, but the volume of injuries/non-participants keeps the camp health picture murky.

### What to watch next
- **MRI results for Kyle Monangai**
- Any clarification on **Jeremyiah Love’s ankle injury**
- Whether **Carson Beck** gets back to full work this week
- Updates on **Tank Dell**, **Brevin Jordan**, and the rest of Houston’s sidelined group
- Progress reports on **Nick Bosa**, **George Kittle**, and the 49ers’ other injured players

Notes and observations from #49ers practice No. 13, a long one that was the last one of this camp open for fans: - Three new additions to the list of players not participating today: G Dominick Puni (concussion), WR Demarcus Robinson (undisclosed) and DT Gracen Halton (ankle). - The Niners also had a few injury scares during practice. DT C.J. West and DE Titus Leo were hurt on separate plays that happened within minutes of each other. Both needed help getting up and then slowly made their way to the locker room for further evaluation. They did not finish the session. - WRs Deebo Samuel and Jacob Cowing were also shaken up but both returned and finished practice. Cowing made a highlight-reel catch after he came back which we'll get to in a minute. And Samuel was all over the place today. - Here's the full list of non participants on Sunday: Puni, Halton, Robinson, RB Christian McCaffrey (tightness), LB Luke Gifford (hamstring), DE Nick Bosa (soreness/tendinitis), FB Kyle Juszczyk (broken finger), OL Brett Toth (concussion), QB Kurtis Rourke (undisclosed/ribs), WR Christian Kirk (calf), S Malik Mustapha (hamstring), RB Kaelon Black (adductor), RB Jordan James (rib), DL Keion White (adductor), OT Vederian Lowe (ankle), CB Nate Hobbs (groin) Players on PUP: TE George Kittle (achilles), RB Isaac Guerendo (pec), DL Mykel Williams (ACL) - Perhaps most notable here: We had our first side field Bosa sighting since he began experiencing tendinitis and soreness early in camp. He did an extensive workout on the side field. A (public) step in the right direction for him. - Rourke didn't practice again and though his specific injury has not been disclosed, OC Klay Kubiak said he doesn't think it will be long before Rourke returns. - WR KhaDarel Hodge was back in pads and uniform after missing on Saturday. - Observations from 1v1 pass rush drills: Gotta start with the rookie, Enrique Cruz Jr. Anyone who has read this space has probably noticed how it's been mentioned that he's struggled often here. So it's only fair we start with praise for what was easily his best performance in these drills in this camp. I wrote "best rep of camp?" after he showed quick feet and second reaction ability against Ogbo Okoronkwo for a win in one rep and then he topped it with his showing on the last rep of this drill against DE Xavier Thomas. Baby steps but at least signs of progress and it's worth noting his fellow line mates were invested, cheering loudly for him for his work in these today... DT Alfred Collins got involved here for the first time in this camp and flashed his power a little bit against Kion Smith after not getting much against Robert Jones... Speaking of, Jones had a handful of solid reps today. Pass pro is the question here but these were mostly more consistent and better than what we've seen... Carver Willis is still getting comfortable here but he had his share of issues trying to block Sebastian Valdez, Osa Odighizuwa and West. - Have mentioned UDFA DT James Thompson Jr. here a bunch but it's worth noting he was first up to step in for West when he was shaken up today. I had Thompson down for a couple of wins in 1v1 and then multiple run stuffs and a shared would-be sack during team drills. - A good day for QBs Brock Purdy and Mac Jones today, including a good amount of completions on deep balls. I had Purdy at 12-of-17 (didn't count a few plays for either penalties or would-be sacks) with Jones at 17-of-20. Purdy dropped in a beautiful deep ball to Malik Turner, who was well covered but made a nice over the shoulder grab for a huge gain. He later connected with Cowing, who was shaken up on a deep pass broken up by Marques Sigle, but returned to dive and haul one in over his shoulder for a big gain. Purdy also hit WR Mike Evans for a big gain, Deebo on a crosser for a chunk and found WR De'Zhaun Stribling on a crosser for a touchdown in the red zone... Jones had a really strong red zone period, throwing touchdowns to Will Pauling and Wesley Grimes and hitting Turner for a deep score outside of the red zone as well. He and Stribling also connected on a deep ball after a well-schemed play had Stribling running man-to-man against LB Larry Wirth. Jones has settled in and looked more like the guy we saw in last year's camp over the past few days. - Nice day for Turner, who has been a practice squad mainstay over the past few years. He made multiple catches deep and is still getting plenty of run in key special teams roles. Wonder how the math works for him to earn a roster spot but he's been a nice option for them shuttling between practice squad and active roster in the past. - Deebo was very involved today and made a handful of plays regardless of who was at QB. He's getting the ball in all kinds of ways. Seemed like maybe he got a stinger after a catch down the left sideline near the end zone but he shook it off (amidst the chuckles of LT Trent Williams) and finished the session. - Frustrating sequence for CB Renardo Green (who has had a nice camp) in the red zone against Evans. He got flagged for DPI on a deep ball for Evans (was a close one but seemed he impeded Evans by grabbing his left arm) then got a (more questionable IMO) holding call. After he defended a throw for Evans in the end zone that fell incomplete, he turned to the official and offered surprise that he didn't get a hat trick of flags. - Some defensive highlights: Stout was in coverage on the deep completion to Turner and it was just a good throw/better catch scenario but he bounced back with sticky coverage on Stribling to force an incompletion to close practice... Lenoir continues to be all over it in coverage... Jack Jones had a PBU on a throw from Jones... Jaden Dugger did a nice job disengaging from a block to make a run stop... Thompson and Sam Okuayinonu broke through for a would-be shared sack... Sigle had the nice pass break up on a deep ball for Cowing. Was also slow to get up up but he was OK... S Ashtyn Davis tipped a pass from Jones that LB Tatum Bethune nearly picked off. - Got to see some various kick and punt returner combinations today. My sense is the Niners would love Jordan Watkins to take a step forward and potentially handle punts. But he muffed one today and was visibly upset about it afterward. Cowing, Will Pauling and even Jack Jones got some opportunities. Hadn't noticed Jones doing it before but he looked pretty comfortable back there... Among the kick return combos (these will rotate and change a lot, of course): Deebo and Cowing/Watkins and Sincere McCormick/Khalil Herbert and Pauling. - That'll do it for this one. Programming notes: I'll be in LA for joint practice with Chargers on Tuesday. From there, Niners don't have many more open practices. These notes will continue in some format but will be tweaked as there are some rule changes in what can be reported from the field and not as season nears. As always, thanks for reading and enjoy your Sunday.

Carson Beck's ribs issue is day to day, Mike LaFleur said today. LaFleur said that Beck's discomfort is still there and Arizona wants Beck to heal a little bit more but said when he'll be ready, he'll be ready to go.

If Kittle, who was injured Jan. 11, *did* play on Sept. 10, it would be impressive but not unprecedented for the #49ers. Michael Crabtree tore his Achilles on May 21, 2013 and played in a Dec. 1 game against the Rams.

Patriots reached an injury settlement with RB Terrell Jennings on Saturday, so he's now a free agent. Sounds like the same will happen with OL Andrew Rupcich, who was put on IR Saturday. His injury is not season-ending. Was Patriots' best backup G option.

Quinn Ewers, who is week to week with his new groin injury sustained Friday, had previously been dealing with another undisclosed injury he has been pushing through since the start of training camp, per source. Maybe this gives him an opportunity to sit back this week and get both of them right.

LAC.summary:
- **Omarion Hampton (RB)** — The Chargers’ backfield is being described as a legit workload puzzle, and OC Mike McDaniel said he plans to play the “hot hand” out of the RB group.
